stories.title: Millions gear up for first total eclipse since 2006
stories.summary: A total solar eclipse will sweep across northern Spain on August 12 in one of Europe's most anticipated astronomical events of the decade. From the Sun's corona to animal behaviour and human emotions, these rare celestial events continue to provide scientists with valuable insights more than two millennia after they were first observed. Selina Sykes reports.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Millions gear up for first total eclipse since 2006. A total solar eclipse will sweep across northern Spain on August 12 in one of Europe's most anticipated astronomical events of the decade. Source: France 24.
